jobs.description: Our Mission: Discovering and describing life and earth - with people, through dialogue.The Museum für Naturkunde Berlin (MfN) is an excellent and integrated research museum of the Leibniz Association with an international reputation and globally networked research infrastructure. jobs.description: At Josef-Schwarz-School, education is about sparking curiosity, encouraging independent thinking and giving teachers the freedom to bring their own ideas to life.
